title: What Zenod does for you

groups.title: Talk to your memory
groups.intro: Ask, tell and call your memory from the web app.

features.title: Call your memory
features.text: Press the phone button in the chat and ask your memory out loud. It answers from your own notes and passes jobs to the memory desk. Nothing from a call is saved unless you keep it.
